boundary_reason: Stable policy selection of 80 revisions, no source-identity truncation. Source verification is not semantic completion.

entries.source: Target knocked back %d grids and dazed.
entries.target: 目标被击退 %d 格并眩晕。

entries.source: This potent elixir can give insights into martial combat to those unlucky enough to ignore the basics.
entries.target: 这种强大的药剂可以给那些忽视基础的人提供最基本的武学技巧。

entries.source:
Targets you have slept take %0.2f mind damage each turn for five turns upon waking.
		The damage will scale with your Mindpower.
entries.target:
被你沉睡的目标醒来后，每回合受到 %0.2f 精神伤害，持续 5 回合。
		伤害受精神强度加成。

entries.source:
#GREY#You feel your life slip away, only to be replaced by pure arcane forces! Your flesh starts to rot on your bones, and your eyes fall apart as you are reborn into a Lich!

#{italic}#You may now choose to customize the appearance of your Lich, this can not be changed afterwards.
entries.target:
#GREY#你感到生命逐渐流逝，取而代之的是纯粹的奥术力量！你的血肉开始腐烂，骨骼逐渐裸露，双眼也随之崩解；你重生为一名巫妖！

#{italic}#你现在可以自定义巫妖的外观，之后将无法更改。

entries.source: It's a large white ant. The air is frigid around it.
entries.target: 一只巨大的白色蚂蚁，它四周的空气都凝固了。

entries.source: A thin pink-skinned creature with long spindly arms.  Half its body is old and wrinkly, and the other half appears quite young.
entries.target: 一只纤瘦的粉皮肤生物，长着细长的手臂。它半边身体又老又皱，另外半边却显得相当年轻。

entries.source: Did over 1500 damage in one attack.
entries.target: 在一次攻击中造成1500点伤害。

entries.source: You cannot use Berserker without a two-handed weapon!
entries.target: 你需要装备一把双手武器来施展狂战士！

entries.source:
You focus on a target zone of radius 2 to make up to %d corrosive seeds appear.
		The first seed will appear at the center of the target zone, while others will appear at random spots.
		Each seed lasts %d turns and will explode when a hostile creature walks over it, knocking the creature back and dealing %0.1f Acid damage within radius 1.
		The damage will increase with your Mindpower.
entries.target:
你集中精神于某块半径 2 的区域，制造出 %d 个腐蚀之种。
		第一个种子会产生于中心处，其他的会随机出现。
     每个种子持续 %d 回合，
		当一个生物走过腐蚀之种时，会在半径 1 的区域内引发一场爆炸，击退对方并造成 %0.1f 点酸性伤害。
		伤害受精神强度加成。

entries.source: #LIGHT_GREEN#Quest '%s' completed! #WHITE#(Press 'j' to see the quest log)
entries.target: #LIGHT_GREEN#任务“%s”完成！#WHITE#（按 J 键查看任务日志）

entries.source:
Entomb yourself in a wall of stone for %d turns.
		At level 4, it becomes targetable.
		Any hostile creature caught in the radius will also suffer %0.2f physical damage.
		Duration and damage will improve with your Spellpower.
entries.target:
召唤岩石堡垒环绕着你，持续 %d 回合。
		在等级 4 时，它可以环绕其他目标。
		范围内的任何敌对生物将受到 %0.2f 点物理伤害。
		持续时间和伤害受法术强度加成。

entries.source: The quick brown fox jumps over the lazy dog.
entries.target: 这只灵巧的棕色狐狸从一只懒狗身上跳了过去。

entries.source: While in your spectral form from Ghost Walk and for %d turns afterwards, damage and detrimental effects have a %d%% chance to harmlessly pass through you.
entries.target: 当你使用游魂行走而进入游魂形态，以及之后的 %d 回合内，你有 %d%% 几率免疫对你造成的伤害和负面效果。

entries.source:
The woman seems to be freed from her bonds.
She stumbles on her feet, her naked body still dripping in blood. 'Please get me out of here!'
entries.target:
这个女人从镣铐束缚中解脱了。
她蹒跚着向你走来，鲜血从她赤裸的皮肤上滴落。“请带我离开这里！”

entries.source:
#{italic}#You find a stone marker at the entrance to a sealed off cave...#{normal}#
#{bold}#Do Not Enter#{normal}#

This cave holds a danger that should never be released upon this world again. Break the seal and you will suffer.

* Under the protection of Berethh
entries.target:
#{italic}#你在一个被封闭的洞穴入口发现了一块石碑……#{normal}#
#{bold}#禁止进入#{normal}#

这个洞穴中封印着绝不能再次释放到世上的危险。打破封印，你必将付出代价。

* 贝里斯之佑

entries.source: #CRIMSON#%s roars with rage shaking off %d mental debuffs!
entries.target: #CRIMSON#%s愤怒地咆哮，摆脱了%d项精神负面效果！

entries.source: Long tunnel to the island of Rel
entries.target: 通往瑞尔岛的漫长通道

entries.source: You require a mainhand weapon to use this talent.
entries.target: 你需要装备主手武器来使用这个技能。

entries.source: I will. We will find a cure for this together.
entries.target: 我会的。我们会一起找到治好你的办法。

entries.source: The light is so powerful it will also banish magical darkness
entries.target: 这一光芒是如此强大，它会消除魔法带来的黑暗。

entries.source: As you approached Derth you saw a huge dark cloud over the small town.
entries.target: 当你接近德斯镇时，你看到一大片漆黑的乌云笼罩在小镇上方。

entries.source: #LIGHT_BLUE#You feel as surge of power as you wear the vestments of the old Human Conclave!
entries.target: #LIGHT_BLUE#穿上这件人类孔克雷夫的古老法袍，你感到全身涌入了一股力量！

entries.source: The target is hexed.  Each time it uses an ability it takes %0.2f fire damage, and talent cooldowns are increased by %s plus 1 turn.
entries.target: 目标受邪术影响，每次施放技能都会受到 %0.2f 火焰伤害，技能冷却延长 %s 再延长 1 回合。

entries.source: Briagh the Great Sand Wyrm. Where do you think Resonating Diamonds come from? They're just regular diamonds until they get stuck between Briagh's scales for a few centuries and get infused with his life rhythms. He sleeps on a hoard of precious gems and metals, you see.
entries.target: 布莱亚，那条巨型沙虫，要不然你认为共鸣钻石是哪里来的？它们原本只是普通的钻石，卡在布莱亚的鳞片间长达几个世纪，逐渐被灌注了生命节律。你看，它正是睡在一堆珍贵宝石和金属上呢。

entries.source: The target is wrapped in disorientating smoke, reducing vision range by %d.
entries.target: 目标被烟雾包围，处于混乱状态，视野减少 %d。

entries.source: and mounted on the barracks wall
entries.target: 并被钉在军营墙上示众

entries.source: Spacetime anomalies that can randomly occur when paradox is to high.
entries.target: 时空变异会在紊乱值较高时随机发生。
